presidentialSuccession.name: Fernando Lugo
presidentialSuccession.party: Alianza Patriótica para el Cambio (later Frente Guasú)
presidentialSuccession.notes: First left president of Paraguay; removed by impeachment in 2012. FSP membership of his coalition as such is to verify: the APC/Frente Guasú contains FSP-member organizations and sent delegates to the Forum (e.g. Hugo Richer). Colorado Party rule preceded and followed him.

fspParties.note: Paraguay's FSP member is the Frente Guasú, the left coalition around Fernando Lugo. Paraguayan politics has been dominated by the Colorado Party (ANR) almost continuously; Lugo's 2008 win (as the broad anti-Colorado Alianza Patriótica para el Cambio) briefly broke that grip, but he never held a congressional majority and was removed by impeachment in 2012. The Frente Guasú holds only a small bloc of seats.

legislativeControl.seats: No FSP force in power; the Colorado Party dominated Congress after the end of the Stroessner dictatorship.
Lugo won the presidency on a broad anti-Colorado ticket but the left held only a minority of Congress; he governed with the Liberals (PLRA) and was impeached and removed in 2012.
Since Lugo's removal the Colorado Party has held the presidency; the Frente Guasú is a small opposition bloc.
